title: The sultan was losing. He asked one man the truth. | Folio 5 — The Honest Historian #Shorts
description:
One night, with the news getting worse and worse, Masud sent for Bu Nasr, alone. Not the vizier, not the generals. The secretary. And he asked him what he really thought. This was the most dangerous question a courtier could be asked. Tell a proud king the truth, and you may lose his favor. Flatter him, and you may lose the kingdom. Bu Nasr was quiet for a moment. And then, carefully, he told the sultan what he thought.

The full story: Folio 5: The Secretary Who Kept the Sultan's Secrets — on our channel and on every podcast app.
